1084	HaShem tells the Jew: you want to enter this infinite process

1097	the eternal union is completed.

1106	what Judaism is.

1108	Judaism is the connection of two opposite matters:
1109	the higher place of "was, is, and will be," which is the superiors, and the lower place, which is limited reality,
1110	which we earlier called the reality of the boxes, and the recognition that as a Jew
1111	you can connect them in such a way that you do not diminish the revelation of the Infinite, you do not give
1112	it up, and you do not give up the reality of the world.

1114	or what is called, nullify the physical and the material.
